title: converge_gitignore omits the events.jsonl rule Intent applies to itself
body:
`converge_gitignore` writes the `.cache/` rule and not the `events.jsonl` rule, so every migrated estate is left with an unignored per-machine file that Intent ignores in its own tree.

**Measured at source and on the Conflab hop (2026-08-28).**

- `converge_gitignore` (`native/rust/crates/intentsvcs/src/facade.rs:159`) writes exactly one rule: `{}/.cache/`.
- Intent's OWN `.gitignore:149` ignores `intent/events.jsonl`, with the reason recorded beside it: *"D53: the event log lives in the store; its file form is produced by `intent export`."*
- The migration emits an empty `intent/events.jsonl` -- `migrate.rs:44` says the empty file means "no recorded history".

So a migrated estate gets `.cache/` ignored automatically and `events.jsonl` not, even though both are per-machine artefacts of the same class and Intent has already ruled on the second one for itself. On Conflab the rule had to be added by hand during the hop; the hand-written comment in that diff names this gap.

**The convergence step knows about one member of a two-member class.** Either `events.jsonl` joins the rules `converge_gitignore` writes, or D53's ruling applies only to Intent's own tree and should say so.

Raised by intent-cc during Phase 4 of the Conflab hop.
